app.name: WhatsApp Manager
app.tagline: Forward the WhatsApp messages that matter, automatically.

common.confirm_delete: Delete this? This cannot be undone.

banner.paused: All rules are paused. Incoming messages are not forwarded.
banner.not_linked: WhatsApp is not linked yet. Link it to start forwarding.
banner.disconnected: WhatsApp is reconnecting. Messages will be forwarded when it is back.
banner.app_unreachable: Cannot reach the app service. It may be restarting.

notice.db_restored: The settings database was damaged and was restored from the latest backup.
notice.uncertain_jobs: The app was closed while sending. Some messages may not have been delivered — check Activity for items marked “Unknown”.

wa.title: WhatsApp account
wa.link_steps: On your phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code.
wa.phone_label: Your WhatsApp number with country code
wa.code_title: Enter this code on your phone
wa.code_steps: On your phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number instead, and type this code.
wa.connected_text: Messages are being watched. You can close this window — the app keeps working in the system tray.
wa.logout_confirm: Unlink this WhatsApp account? Rules will stop until you link again.
wa.disconnected_text: Connection lost. The app reconnects automatically.
wa.dedicated_tip: Tip: use a dedicated WhatsApp number for automation. Sending many messages quickly can get a number restricted by WhatsApp.

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: A rule watches incoming messages and forwards the ones that match.
rules.empty_text: Create a rule to start forwarding messages. Start from a template — you can change everything later.
rules.tpl_links_email_text: When someone posts a link in a group, email it.
rules.tpl_contact_wa_text: Forward every message from one contact to another number.
rules.tpl_keyword_group_text: When a message contains a word like “urgent”, forward it to a group.
rules.tpl_blank_text: Build your own rule step by step.
rules.act_wa_copy: send a copy on WhatsApp to {to}

editor.source_q: Which chats should this rule watch?
editor.senders_text: Useful in groups: only react to what certain members write.
editor.cond_link_text: Web addresses like https://… or example.com
editor.cond_keywords_text: Any or all of the words you type
editor.words_placeholder: Type a word and press Enter
editor.words_hint: Arabic spelling variants and diacritics are matched automatically (e.g. أ/ا, ة/ه).
editor.add_wa_text: To a contact, a phone number or a group
editor.add_email_text: To one or more email addresses
editor.wa_mode_copy: Send a copy with sender name
editor.wa_mode_copy_text: Adds “From … in …” so the receiver knows the source
editor.include_media: Attach photos and files (up to 20 MB)
editor.email_not_ready: Email is not set up yet. You can save the rule, but it stays off until email works.
editor.loop_warning: This destination is also watched by a rule. The app prevents loops, but double-check this is intended.
editor.name: Rule name
editor.own_messages: Also forward messages I send myself
editor.test_text: Type a sample message to check whether this rule would forward it. Nothing is sent.
editor.test_nomatch: This message would not be forwarded
editor.only_new: Only messages that arrive after the rule is saved are forwarded.

picker.not_connected: Link WhatsApp to load your groups and contacts.
picker.not_on_wa: This number is not on WhatsApp.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Every incoming message, which rule matched, and where it was sent.
activity.uncertain_help: The app stopped while sending this. It may or may not have arrived — send again only if needed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart_text: Runs in the system tray when you sign in, so no message is missed.
settings.autostart_store: Managed by Windows: Task Manager → Startup apps.
settings.pause_text: Messages are still received and logged, but nothing is forwarded.
settings.catchup_text: After the PC was off or offline, messages older than this are not forwarded.
settings.rate_text: Lower is safer. WhatsApp may restrict numbers that send too fast.
settings.export_text: Save your rules to a file (no passwords are included).
settings.import_text: Load rules from a file. Imported rules only apply to new messages.
settings.imported_disabled: {n} rules with email stay off until email is set up.
settings.diagnostics_text: A zip with logs and settings (no passwords) to share when asking for help.
settings.license: Open source under the MIT licence.
settings.credits: WhatsApp connectivity by GoWA (go-whatsapp-web-multidevice, MIT). Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
settings.privacy: Your messages and settings stay on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere except WhatsApp traffic and the emails your rules send.
settings.cleanup_text: Old messages, activity history and downloaded files are deleted automatically. Messages still waiting to be sent are kept.
settings.subject_counter_text: Adds a running number, e.g. “[WhatsApp #42]”, so Gmail and Outlook show every forwarded message separately instead of grouping them into one conversation.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP) settings
smtp.intro: Emails are sent through your own email account. Choose your provider, enter the address and password, then send a test email.
smtp.quick_text: Enter your email and password and the app finds the server settings.
smtp.password_hint: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and iCloud need an “app password” — not your normal password.
smtp.app_password_help: How to create an app password
smtp.skip_verify: Skip certificate check (only for internal servers)
smtp.test_ok: Test email sent. Check the inbox (and spam folder).
smtp.saved_untested: Saved. Send a test email to activate email rules.

welcome.title: Welcome to WhatsApp Manager
welcome.text: Forward important WhatsApp messages to the right people — automatically. Setup takes about two minutes.
welcome.email_text: Needed only if you want rules that send emails. You can do this later in Settings.
welcome.rule_text: Pick a template to start. You can change everything later.
welcome.done_text: The app runs in the system tray and starts with Windows. You can close this window anytime.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Close this window and open the app again from the tray.
errors.not_retryable: This item cannot be sent again.
errors.import_invalid: This file is not a valid rules export.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number with country code (8–15 digits).
errors.gowa_missing: The WhatsApp service files are missing. Please reinstall the app.

wa.not_logged_in: WhatsApp is not linked or not connected.
wa.unavailable: The WhatsApp service is starting or not responding. Try again in a moment.
wa.offline: WhatsApp offline — will send when connected

rule.chats_required: Choose at least one chat to watch.
rule.types_required: Choose at least one message type.
rule.wa_target_required: Choose who receives the WhatsApp message.
rule.wa_target_invalid: The WhatsApp destination is not valid.
rule.email_required: Add at least one email address.
rule.email_invalid: One of the email addresses is not valid.
rule.smtp_not_ready: Email is not set up and tested yet. Set up email first, or save the rule turned off.

smtp.from_invalid: Enter a valid sender email address.
smtp.reply_to_invalid: The reply-to address is not valid.
smtp.insecure_auth: Logging in without encryption sends your password in clear text. Choose STARTTLS or SSL, or allow it under Advanced.
smtp.auth_failed: Wrong username or password. Many providers need an app password.
smtp.certificate: The server's security certificate is not trusted.
smtp.tls_failed: Could not start a secure connection. Try another security option or port.
smtp.sender_rejected: The server refused the sender address.
smtp.recipient_rejected: The server refused the recipient address.
smtp.unreachable: Cannot reach the mail server. Check the server name, port and internet connection.
smtp.temporary: The mail server is busy. The app will retry.
smtp.unknown: The mail server returned an error.
smtp.autodetect_failed: Could not find the settings automatically. Choose your provider or enter the server manually.
